# Vektorsynapse

> Full-Stack Software Studio building production-grade web, mobile and desktop applications.

Vektorsynapse is a software engineering studio that helps businesses, founders, and international teams turn complex requirements into high-performance digital products. We provide single-point technical accountability across the entire software lifecycle — from architectural planning and UI engineering to API development, database design, cloud deployment, and performance optimization.

## Full Documentation
- [Full LLMs Knowledge Base](https://vektorsynapse.netlify.app/llms-full.txt): Detailed breakdown of engineering standards, architecture, tech stacks, and case studies.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Business Websites**: High-performance, SEO-optimized, mobile-responsive corporate platforms (90+ Google PageSpeed, zero layout shift).
- **Web Applications**: Scalable single-page and full-stack web applications built with Next.js, React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
- **Mobile Applications**: Cross-platform native mobile applications engineered in Flutter with offline caching and real-time syncing.
- **Desktop Software**: Offline-first commercial billing, inventory, and point-of-sale desktop software built with Electron and SQLite.
- **API & Cloud Integrations**: Secure REST APIs, database architecture (PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB), and cloud infrastructure deployment (Vercel, Netlify).

## Selected Work & Case Studies (Verified Facts)
- **Comfort Floors & Bathrooms** (Ireland): International home renovation platform with sub-second loading (92/100 PageSpeed, 0.00 CLS) built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **JNTUA College of Engineering Portal** (India): Institutional web portal serving thousands of active engineering students, faculty, and administrative staff with 100% uptime.
- **SuperCabs** (India): Cross-platform mobile cab rental and mobility app frontend built with Flutter, Dart, Firebase Auth, and FCM.
- **Medcare** (India): Offline-first Windows commercial billing software with local SQLite database for retail clinical counters, operating with zero cloud dependencies.
- **Sayed Wedding Invitation**: Bilingual 3D interactive WebGL digital invitation engineered with Three.js, GSAP, and zero-JS fallbacks.
- **Agnikula Kshatriyas IT Solutions**: Corporate enterprise web platform built with NestJS, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Operating Model & Working Principles
- **Global Availability**: Operates internationally with time-zone overlap across IST, GMT, and EST.
- **Pricing**: Transparent fixed-price milestone contracts with clearly defined deliverables and zero surprise invoices.
- **Code Ownership**: 100% client intellectual property ownership upon project delivery, with documented codebases and deployment runbooks.
